answer: An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The terrace schedule is applied in oasis and dawn shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2299 identities would post 4603 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
